title: Frank-native Visual State Transition Graph with alias-safe task binding
finding: Action-grounded transition structure is a promising experience representation, but current GUI-transition diagnostics show transition understanding, asynchronous state verification, hidden operations and pixel-vs-structure conflicts remain substantial failure modes. The Frank-native candidate therefore stores only verified action/outcome transitions, binds them to task/provenance state, preserves conflicting evidence, and treats retrieval as context/proposal rather than truth or authority.
why_interesting_for_target_architecture: It can compose QNDRF feature reuse and PAR/EAP retrieval with UnifiedDB/ClayGraph while preserving the one-module semantic architecture and deterministic authority boundary.
unresolved_uncertainty: Whether explicit runtime transition memory beats direct memory or Qwen-only under target-VPS total cost and real Frank experience dose is unknown.
falsifier: Run the matched VSTG matrix and dose-response on frozen H1 episodes with alias/hidden-operation/pixel-structure-conflict controls and complete end-to-end metrics.
